'''Mike Gemme LS''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Mike Gemme]] posted on DeckTech. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-4318">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/4318 DeckTech post 4318], DeckTech (michael "Deck" Gemme, 14 March 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/4318/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/4318/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018193921/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/4318/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Blacks  Gats  and Phat Whips in the City'''
* '''Author:''' michael "Deck" Gemme
* '''Published:''' March 14, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This deck is made in the likeness of what it would be like in the SWCCG ghettomany cards will have their own descriptions as to why they will be in the deck

=== Strategy ===

Okay so this deck is MESSED but its funny as hell you gotta admit thats the way it would be in a cloud city gang i wish fozec was a LS guy so bad anyways.. i was gonna use SGT doallyn cause of his black mask but not enough room for a true ghetto playa.  ANYWAYS this is just a sweet deck gimmie a rating that judges its quality into the concept and not so much how it would do at worlds cause we all know what would happen PEACE
